Title: Plain clause
Prompt: Rewrite this clause in plain language. Then list any meaning you might have changed. Do not add rights.
Check: The change list is empty or you fix it.

Title: Who it applies to
Prompt: Say who the clause binds, using only the nouns in the clause. If it is unclear, say unclear.
Check: You do not guess the party.

Title: What the person must do
Prompt: List the obligations as actions. If a sentence is not an obligation, leave it out and say so.

Title: Defined terms
Prompt: List defined terms and ask me for any definition that is not in the paste.

Title: Questions for counsel
Prompt: Write five questions a lawyer should answer. Do not answer them yourself.

Title: Heading
Prompt: Write a heading a customer can scan. Do not make it friendlier than the clause.
